title: Pace every seat write — one shared throttle in front of the five PM write scripts (maintainer 「截流应该要加」)
body:
Path: none | tooling | maintainer-directed — dispatched at filing, never queued

Class (c). Filed by the director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`) under the maintainer's verbatim 「截流应该要加」 (chat, 2026-09-21), answering the 「Not in this card」 list of #19570 — the sentence ruling #208 R6 requires before a new instrument. Why now: two seat accounts were suspended by GitHub today during bulk issue operations; the charter rule 「paced writes」 lands in #19570, this card makes it mechanical so no seat has to remember it.

## The change (`scripts/pm/**`, Tier S — the director seat lands it after an at-tier read)

1. **One helper, `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs`**, exporting `paceWrite({ token, kind })` (awaited before a write) and `noteResponse({ token, status, headers })` (called after). It keeps a small per-user log at `~/.cache/objectstack-pm/write-pace.jsonl` (override `OS_PM_WRITE_PACE_FILE`), keyed by a short SHA-256 prefix of the token — ⛔ never the token itself — one line per write with a timestamp, pruned to the trailing hour on every read.
2. **Rules, defaults as the charter states them**: at least **3 s** since the previous write by the same token (sleep the remainder, print one line saying so); at most **40 writes in the trailing 60 min** per token — the 41st is **refused** with a distinct exit code and a prescription (the count, when the window reopens, what to fold into fewer writes), ⛔ never a silent wait; a **429**, or a 403 whose body names the secondary rate limit, or `retry-after` / `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, writes a **stop marker** (30 min, or `retry-after` if longer) after which every write by that token is refused with the marker's expiry printed, until it expires. Env overrides `OS_PM_WRITE_MIN_GAP_MS` and `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX` for tests only; the defaults are the contract.
3. **Wired into every write path** — the `fetch` that issues POST / PATCH / PUT / DELETE in `post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `sweep-closed-cards.mjs`, `sweep-stale-finding.mjs` (`git grep -n "method:" scripts/pm` is the census); `--dry-run` paths do not count and do not sleep. `ensure-pm-labels.sh` runs through `gh` under the maintainer's hand and stays out.
4. **`--self-test`** offline with an injected clock (gap sleep, the 41st refusal, the stop marker from a 429, pruning, the token never appearing in the file) and **`--status`** printing the trailing-hour count and any active marker for the current token, so a seat can read its own budget before a batch.

## Acceptance

Self-test exit 0 with its case count; a real `post-stamped.mjs --dry-run` unchanged; the five scripts each show the two calls around their write (`git grep -n 'paceWrite\|noteResponse' scripts/pm`); the derived gate families green (`dispatch-gates --commands`, exit codes captured before any pipe); a changeset is not needed (nothing under `packages/**`, `skip-changeset`).

Dedupe: `git grep -n -i 'rate.limit\|throttle\|pace' scripts/pm` — the scripts classify a 429 today (`classifyHttp` in `label-write.mjs`) but none paces or counts; no open card on the board carries a throttle (titles over the open set for `throttle|pace|rate limit` → 0, control `label-write` → 2).
